# teams_online_audio_conferencing_routing_policy (Resource)

Manages the OnlineAudioConferencingRoutingPolicy policy via New-CsOnlineAudioConferencingRoutingPolicy / Get-CsOnlineAudioConferencingRoutingPolicy / Set-CsOnlineAudioConferencingRoutingPolicy / Remove-CsOnlineAudioConferencingRoutingPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `online_pstn_usages` (String) Maps to the -OnlinePstnUsages parameter.
- `route_type` (String) Maps to the -RouteType parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
